'''Amma''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. After a [[Amma protest|civilian insurrection]] on the planet, the city was placed under martial law by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lesan Ramier]].
